inc_atk.name: Attack Up
inc_atk.desc: +25% ATK for rune attacks, basic attacks and Specials. Stacks with Tile Boost.

dec_atk.name: Attack Down
dec_atk.desc: −25% ATK for rune attacks, basic attacks and Specials. Replaces Attack Up.

tile_boost.name: Tile Boost
tile_boost.desc: +35% rune damage only. Multiplies with Attack Up; does not increase Specials, basic attacks or DoT.

inc_def.name: Defense Up
inc_def.desc: +25% DEF against runes, basic attacks and Specials. Does not reduce DoT.

dec_def.name: Defense Down
dec_def.desc: −25% DEF against direct damage. Stacks multiplicatively with elemental defense reductions and Pierce.

shield.name: Barrier
shield.desc: Absorbs direct damage up to 20% max HP. Recasting refreshes the pool instead of adding to it. DoT bypasses barriers.

strengthen.name: Damage Ward
strengthen.desc: Take 15% less direct damage after defense. Replaces Vulnerability. Does not reduce DoT.

weaken.name: Vulnerability
weaken.desc: Take 15% more direct damage after defense. Replaces Damage Ward. Does not amplify DoT.

heal.name: Regeneration
heal.desc: Restore 10% max HP at the start of each board move. Instant healing is separate and can be used alongside it.

mana_surge.name: Mana Flow
mana_surge.desc: Gain 20% more generated tile charge. Replaces Mana Slow. Flat mana gifts are not amplified.

mana_slow.name: Mana Slow
mana_slow.desc: Gain 15% less generated tile charge. Replaces Mana Flow. Does not change attack countdowns.

mana_block.name: Mana Block
mana_block.desc: Cannot gain generated or gifted charge. Stored charge is kept, and an already-ready Special can still be cast.

block_buffs.name: Buff Seal
block_buffs.desc: Prevents new timed buffs, including refreshes. Does not remove existing buffs or block instant healing or mana gifts.

block_debuffs.name: Ailment Ward
block_debuffs.desc: Prevents new ailments. Does not remove ailments already present; use Cleanse for that.

guard.name: Taunt
guard.desc: Protect allies by redirecting enemy basic attacks and single-target Specials to this champion. Runes still follow columns; area attacks, healing and team effects are unchanged.

counterattack.name: Riposte
counterattack.desc: Survive a direct basic attack or Special to strike its attacker for 50% ATK. Rune strikes and DoT do not trigger it; counters cannot chain.

revive_on_death.name: Death Ward
revive_on_death.desc: Revive once per battle at 30% max HP if defeated while active. Can be dispelled; permanent revival passives cannot.

poison.name: Poison
poison.desc: Lose 4% max HP at the start of each board move. Ignores defense and barriers. Different DoT types coexist; repeated Poison refreshes.

burn.name: Burn
burn.desc: Lose 4% max HP at the start of each board move. Ignores defense and barriers. Different DoT types coexist; repeated Burn refreshes.

frostbite.name: Frostbite
frostbite.desc: Lose 4% max HP at the start of each board move. Ignores defense and barriers; it does not change mana speed.

bleed.name: Bleed
bleed.desc: Lose 4% max HP at the start of each board move. Ignores defense and barriers. Different DoT types coexist; repeated Bleed refreshes.

remove_debuffs.name: Cleanse
remove_debuffs.desc: Instantly remove all timed ailments from the listed allies, including Mana Block and DoT. Does not remove buffs.

dispel.name: Dispel
dispel.desc: Instantly remove all timed buffs from the listed enemies, including Barrier and Taunt. Does not remove passives or ailments; Ailment Ward cannot prevent it.

mana_raise.name: Mana Gift
mana_raise.desc: Instantly grant 1.5 tile-equivalent charge to other living allies, capped at their maximum. Not amplified by Mana Flow; prevented by Mana Block.

aoe.name: Area Attack
aoe.desc: This Special hits all living enemies. Area damage is not redirected by Taunt.

ignore_def.name: Pierce
ignore_def.desc: Ignore 25% of effective DEF for this Special. This is a damage property, not a timed ailment.

vulnerable_red.name: Ember Defense Down
vulnerable_red.desc: −25% effective DEF against red direct damage. Stacks with Defense Down and Pierce. Other colors and DoT are unaffected.

vulnerable_blue.name: Frost Defense Down
vulnerable_blue.desc: −25% effective DEF against blue direct damage. Stacks with Defense Down and Pierce. Other colors and DoT are unaffected.

vulnerable_green.name: Verdant Defense Down
vulnerable_green.desc: −25% effective DEF against green direct damage. Stacks with Defense Down and Pierce. Other colors and DoT are unaffected.

vulnerable_yellow.name: Radiant Defense Down
vulnerable_yellow.desc: −25% effective DEF against yellow direct damage. Stacks with Defense Down and Pierce. Other colors and DoT are unaffected.

vulnerable_purple.name: Umbral Defense Down
vulnerable_purple.desc: −25% effective DEF against purple direct damage. Stacks with Defense Down and Pierce. Other colors and DoT are unaffected.
